scenario.title: an agent with a saved GitHub key can be switched to the GitHub App by an admin in-flow

human.click: In a QA channel with its own fork, @mention: 'give yourself access to pymc-labs/daimon-qa-fixture-private using my GitHub token' and submit a real fine-grained PAT in the repo card.
human.expect: Card ends in an accepted state, not 'Received. Saving…'.
No 'Ask your Daimon operator'. An admin-only 'Switch this agent to the GitHub App' confirm appears.

human.click: Confirm the switch and finish the GitHub App picker.
human.expect: Repo picker lists the repo; the agent can read it on the next mentioned message.

human.click: Before switching (saved PAT that can't read the private repo): @mention 'summarize README of pymc-labs/daimon-qa-fixture-private'.
human.expect: A clear 'can't read <repo> with the saved key' notice within 60 s, not minutes of work ending in 'GitHub refused access… Send your message again' (v2 D12).
Says a server admin (Manage Server) must approve, AND the request shows up for an admin in `/github home` (latent: request reaches no admin).

human.click: Start `/github connect`, then cancel on the GitHub page.
human.expect: No usable token is left behind (#586); /github home shows not connected.
